args.goal: Reuse the committed Stream Commerce draft, verification and any prior equivalent negative control. Choose one check explicitly offered in the draft, ideally identifier preservation or image-reference mapping. Run the documented catalogue verifier on the existing fictional fixture and on a temporary copy changing exactly one field relevant to that check. Capture the executed command, exit statuses, actual failed check names, inputs and draft hashes, and any manual steps needed to interpret the result. If the negative control reveals a limitation, give the operator exact wording to narrow the claim before the draft goes to a decision. Save and read back the result under products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/ before closing with a lesson under a valid lease. No additional prospecting, correspondence, purchase, public site edit or deployment.

description: Stream Commerce’s public service page confirms Shopify Plus migration work, and the catalogue verifier passed all 12 checks on a fictional fixture. The published contact address provides a route for an operator-approved inquiry. Subcontracting demand and the provisional CAD 60 fee remain hypotheses. I’m advancing the existing draft to one send-or-decline decision and adding a negative control the operator can use to demonstrate what the service catches. The SQLite quote release depends on eligible independent approval of its exact digest. The live homepage differs from the candidate, so that release remains separate from the catalogue work. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, leaving demand unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 verified available and no verified revenue.
